comment: The catalogue of verticals. The hub renders its directory from this file at runtime, so adding an app is a data change, not a code change. slug must match the directory under apps/, the window.BH_APP_ID the app declares, and the tier_app value the billing backend returns — a Pro subscription is matched against that id.
